blocks.label: Re-anchor
blocks.text: Circling my earlier note back to the top, in case it got buried.

blocks.label: New angle
blocks.guidance: Add ONE new, specific hook not in the first email, sharpened for a larger organisation: reference a concrete team, product line, or recent announcement, and tie it in one clause to a single relevant piece of the candidate's evidence and to the specific function they could support. At most two tight sentences. Do not recap the first email. No filler openers.

blocks.label: Single ask
blocks.text: If it is easier, happy to be pointed to whoever owns this. Open to a short call?

style.notes: For a larger firm, precision and a clear routing offer matter: make it trivially easy to forward or to say who owns this. One new specific hook, one low-friction ask. No apology, no chasing tone.
